faqs.question: What are the 12 Nepali rashis (zodiac signs)?
faqs.answer: The 12 Vedic rashis are: Mesha (Aries), Vrisha (Taurus), Mithun (Gemini), Karkat (Cancer), Simha (Leo), Kanya (Virgo), Tula (Libra), Vrischik (Scorpio), Dhanu (Sagittarius), Makar (Capricorn), Kumbha (Aquarius), Meen (Pisces). In Nepali: मेष, वृष, मिथुन, कर्कट, सिंह, कन्या, तुला, वृश्चिक, धनु, मकर, कुम्भ, मीन.
